text:
jordan_cust: FYI customer on Dedicated (vpc-east) is hitting repeated 422s when calling a tool. Error: SchemaValidationError: unexpected field 'userId' — payload rejected. They said this started after we migrated/renamed the tool yesterday. Repro steps + logs below.

anna_support: thanks — can you paste request_id + exact timestamp? Also are they using SDK v2 or REST?

jordan_cust: request_id=req_01H8ZQ7A9, ts=1792501205. Using SDK v2. Example payload we received from them: 
```json
{"tool": "userLookup", "args": {"userId": "abc123"}}
```

miguel_oncall: hmm. That payload uses `userLookup` (camelCase). Our router/registry treats tool names case-sensitively in some paths. We did a registry sync/rename flow last night — @lee_runtime can you check registry aliases?

lee_runtime: pulling registry snapshot now. Canonical entry is `UserLookup` (PascalCase). There's an alias for `user_lookup` (snake_case) created by the migration, but I don't see `userLookup` (camelCase) in alias map. Router only lowercases for some lookups; it doesn't generate camelCase aliases. Likely cause.

sarah_product: customers were told rename would keep common name variants working. Looks like the migration created snake_case and original but missed camelCase. Need quick mitigation and a durable fix.

lee_runtime: quick mitigation: add explicit alias `userLookup` -> `UserLookup` in registry and flush in-memory cache on all regions. I can push that now.

deploy-bot: registry-service: alias-update script started by miguel (1792501300)

deploy-bot: registry-service: alias-update completed (1792501312) — aliases added: ["userLookup" -> "UserLookup"]

anna_support: can you ask customer to retry?

jordan_cust: retried at 1792501320, now getting 200. Thanks — they confirm everything back to normal.

miguel_oncall: good. Root cause summary: rename pipeline created snake_case alias but not camelCase one; SDKs in wild produce various case styles (camelCase common). Short-term fix: explicit alias add + cache flush (done). Mid-term: update migration to generate common case variants (snake, kebab, camel, pascal) when creating aliases. Long-term: router should canonicalize/normalize more aggressively or consult alias lookup service.

lee_runtime: filing ENG-4567 with repro (payload above), registry dump, and proposed fixes. I'll attach timing and the alias update script used.

sarah_product: I'll update the migration docs and add a note in the SDK docs about tool-name case caveats until we ship the fix.

anna_support: I'll close the support ticket and send the customer a short explanation and mitigation note. Will also post brief postmortem to #eng-runtime.

jordan_cust: thanks everyone. Appreciate the fast turnaround.
